outcome: Successful vaginal delivery of both twins
Conversion to cesarean delivery for the second twin
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies who underwent a planned vaginal delivery
finding: Conversion to cesarean delivery occurred in only 4.2% of planned twin vaginal deliveries, and there were no significant differences in maternal and fetal outcomes between successful vaginal delivery and conversion to cesarean delivery for the second twin.
